data.name: Broken Frontier
data.detailed_description:
Broken Frontier is an MMORPG shooter set in a post-apocalyptic America. It features 3rd person gunplay, vehicles with realistic physics and MMORPG genre staples like character creation, classes and professions, massive server wars, crafting and player economy. All taking place in a persistent open world that is brimming with life despite the apocalypse.

It's been a hundred years since a global catastrophe struck Earth in the early 2000s, changing humanity forever. Now, the New States are controlled by three wildly different factions locked in endless discord. The balance of power and the country's future will be defined by you.

Join forces with your faction allies and battle rival players in relentless wars over territory and glory. Take down outposts and conquer entire cities. Loot them, control them and shape the battlefield to your will. Remember: PvP is always on.

Explore the unpredictable wildlands of post-apocalyptic Oregon and the last remaining states. Beware giant, deadly plants, mutated predators and violent weather anomalies. Everything in this world wants to kill and eat you. Make sure you strike first.

Customize your character and vehicles from the ground up, hone your skills, and climb the ranks of your faction. Choose from a variety of classes and professions to leave your mark on this world. Hunt, steal, and craft valuable resources to trade with other players and rebuild the New States.

Fight in massive 150-player faction wars over territory. Survive a vast and wild open world. Hunt, steal, craft and trade. The country's future is yours to shape.
